history_boundary.detail: The locally available repository is shallow at f1e62799492e82ef677a9cb8b2128f1e924a7d7b and a85e3d47f6102853eea44d328e06ee384a169bd4. All three families are present at that boundary, so their original creation commits and any earlier branch-only history are unavailable locally. Dates below are first locally evidenced appearances, not claimed creation dates.

non_conflation_conclusion.detail: The dialogue family can now be decomposed without asserting succession: WDM is a reachable alternate runtime; council Bus/Message/Referee are its exercised dependencies; the separately tested standalone runner and its deterministic provider-named stubs remain smaller explicit unknowns. council_adapters/ and the governance council remain separate families, and no locally available history or source declares a predecessor/successor relationship among them.

surfaces.current_role: Privilege-gated, one-shot respond/initiate dialogue orchestration reached through CLI, FastAPI, Cathedral GUI, direct library callers, and focused tests.
surfaces.original_role: The earliest locally visible trees already contain the present WDM package, three entry surfaces, deterministic provider-named adapters, logging, and council imports; pre-boundary intent is unavailable.
surfaces.provider_network_relationship: WDM instantiates its own OpenAI-, DeepSeek-, and Mistral-named adapters. They read optional provider credential environment variables but return locally constructed deterministic strings for both missing and present keys; they import no provider SDK and make no HTTP or network call. The configured allowlist is loaded by no execution path.
surfaces.authority_relationship: Policy selects deny/respond/initiate as orchestration data. WDM cannot confer or satisfy capabilities, authorize host effects, mutate authoritative runtime state, participate in maintenance or adoption, or invoke ControlPlaneKernel/RuntimeGovernor. It writes configured local transcript, stream, summary, presence, cheers, and migration-ledger JSONL files; it launches no subprocess and performs no repository mutation by design.
surfaces.persistence: Allowed runs create parent directories and append/write dialogue JSONL, summary JSONL, presence JSONL, stream JSONL, optional cheers JSONL, and migration-ledger checksum records. Denied runs return before writes.
unresolved_contradictions: Original creation and adoption intent precede the local shallow boundary.
No current source establishes whether the provider-named adapters ever made live calls before the visible history.
The API module is documented but no repository-owned server launch wiring was found.
state_inputs: optional provider credential environment variables (presence only)
state_outputs: local JSONL artifacts and migration-ledger receipts on allowed runs
surfaces.local_model_relationship: No local-model runtime, model catalog, inference server, or local-model invocation is imported or called.

surfaces.current_role: Privilege-gated in-memory Message schema, Bus transcript collector/JSONL dumper, and Referee convergence check required by WDM and reused by the standalone council runner.
surfaces.original_role: Already shared between WDM and the standalone council runner at the shallow history boundary; earlier origin is unavailable.
surfaces.wdm_dependency_relationship: Direct, exercised dependency: WDM publishes Message instances to Bus, asks Referee whether answer rounds are stable, serializes Bus history, and types summaries as Message iterables.
surfaces.provider_network_relationship: No provider SDK, credential read, HTTP, network, local-model, or subprocess behavior.
surfaces.authority_relationship: Carries dialogue data, chooses an early-stop condition, and writes JSONL only when Bus.dump_jsonl is called. It cannot grant capabilities or authorize host, maintenance, adoption, control-plane, or governor effects.
unresolved_contradictions: Pre-boundary origin and original ownership are unavailable.
